goal: Independently collect and analyze all local and online evidence needed before RICON Reforger implementation, then cross-audit Claude and Codex corpora for completeness, integrity, validity, quality, contradictions, and unresolved gaps.
known_facts: fact_016: ITU-R P.525/P.526 provide primary free-space/diffraction references; P.526 offers several geometry-dependent models, not one universal multi-edge shortcut.
fact_017: ITU-R P.838 is the primary specific-rain-attenuation model; the A3 weather formula is a heuristic and is not demonstrated as P.838-compliant.
fact_018: ITU-R P.368 covers ground wave below 30 MHz and P.530 covers terrestrial LOS/multipath; the current HF and multipath branches remain approximations.

fact_019: Current signal_core smoke tests verify basic numerical behavior, diffraction helper output, NaN rejection, and interference plumbing but do not physically calibrate terrain, materials, weather, or intelligibility.
fact_020: A3 signal comments cite ACRE2 and public standards; the project NOTICE mandates conceptual-reference-only use and clean-room derivation.
fact_021: Official Enforce performance guidance recommends avoiding per-frame big loops, centralizing work, spreading calculations across frames, and caching results.
fact_022: Official Reforger profiling and replication budget tools are runtime-only; no measured 30/60-player budget can be produced in the current phase.
fact_023: Full directed pair counts are 870 at 30 players and 3540 at 60; three active talkers reduce candidate pairs to 87 and 177 before spatial/frequency culling.
fact_024: Official Rpl streamingBudget and staggeringBudget trade server cost against delayed relevance/pop-in and therefore must be part of far-radio tests.
fact_025: 3GPP TS 23.003 is the primary numbering/addressing/identification specification relevant to IMSI/MSISDN analogues.
fact_026: 3GPP TS 23.040 is the primary SMS realization specification; RICON's bounded session queue is a gameplay subset, not standards parity.
fact_027: 3GPP TS 24.090 defines USSD; dialing *100# and receiving an SMS is an intentional hybrid gameplay abstraction and must be labeled as such.
fact_028: Official Workbench docs allow simple Script Editor execution without loading a world, but current owner permission is compile/static only, so this capability remains unused.
fact_029: Official Autotest execution opens World Editor or game runtime and is blocked by the no-Play rule.
fact_030: Reference projects remain architecture/behavior evidence only unless each source file and asset has an explicitly compatible license and provenance review.
compressed_summary: Cycle 1 established the static VoN/radio API surface, generic ACP signal capability, unresolved relay/audio binding, Rpl streaming risk, incomplete game install, evidence-level boundaries, Workshop rights requirements, and an official reverse-engineering prohibition that conflicts with the provisional RE gate.
rejected_branches: Treating RelayTransceiver type existence as proof of forwarding
Treating OnReceive quality as proof of writable VoN quality
Treating owner approval alone as legal authorization for reverse engineering
Claiming ITU calibration from code comments
Claiming 3GPP compliance for simplified SMS/USSD gameplay
Using full O(P^2) routing as the 30/60-player design
